Fast-setting, cement-based adhesive for fixing a wide range of ceramic, mosaics and porcelain tiles to the majority of conventional solid wall and floor backgrounds such as sand, cement screeds, renders concrete and plaster. Water-resistant, once set, and can be used both in interior or exterior situations. Ideal for bathrooms, shower enclosures, kitchens, conservatories and porches.
b: Suitable for Ceramic, Mosaic & Porcelain Tiles
